# Select

Choose a value inside a list.
See [Select guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/select/design/)

## Examples

### When to use

The `Select` component is designed to be used in forms to select a single value from a list of options and submit data.

Use the <LinkTo kind="Components/ComboBox" story="docs">ComboBox</LinkTo> when there is a large list of options to choose from.

<Canvas of={SelectStories.Basic} />

```css
.w-288 {
  width: 288px;
}
```

### Placeholder

The `<select>` element have no `placeholder` attribute, but you can simulate one by adding a hidden option and the `ds-select--has-placeholder` class. You'll have to use JavaScript to listen for the `onChange` event and remove this class when a value is selected.
